svg.title: Simon Fraser University / Security Services — fan
svg.desc: Cream fan with a navy edge. Simon Fraser University’s full-colour arms (shield and motto scroll, from the university’s 2015 brand guidelines) in the centre; SIMON FRASER UNIVERSITY along the upper edge and SECURITY SERVICES along the lower edges, outlined in Roboto Condensed Bold. Interpreted from a 113 × 48 collector-board photograph: the embroidered alphabet, thread colours and the arms’ stitched detail are not verified.
